allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of In-principle Approvals for listing of up to 50,000 Equity Shares of face value of ₹2/- each under Dhanuka Employee Stock Option Plan 2026 ("ESOP 2026" / "Plan")

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Approval of granting of loan upto Rs. 15 Crore in one or more tranches to the proposed Dhanuka Employee Stock Benefits Trust for the sole purpose of acquisition of equity shares from open market and administration of SAR 2026 in accordance with the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.'.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange about  approval of Dhanuka Employee Stock Option Plan 2026 and Dhanuka Stock Appreciation Rights Plan 2026
